description: Prediction markets on Cardano (Bodega Market), read from the chain: each market's question, the probability its automated market maker currently gives YES and NO (percent), when trading ends, the funds in the market, traded volume and, once published, the outcome. Use it for "what are the odds of …" or "which prediction markets are open" questions. Amounts are in the market's payment token (ADA unless `paymentToken` says otherwise). Outcomes are published on chain by the Bodega team, not by a decentralised oracle; most markets are sports events. Odds are a market price, not a forecast you should present as fact: name the source and the time.

limit.description: How many markets to return (1-50, default 15).

query.description: Only markets whose question contains this text.

sort.description: Ordering. Default: deadline (soonest first for open markets, latest first otherwise). volume = all-time traded volume; activity = most recently traded.

status.description: open = trading now; awaiting = trading ended, no result published yet; resolved = result published, winners can claim; closed = wound up.

name: list_prediction_markets
title: Prediction markets and their odds
